verdict.rationale: Capacities is object-type-first: users define custom object types with core properties [capacities-docs-26][capacities-docs-29]. Templates can prefill those properties [capacities-docs-9], AI can auto-fill them [capacities-docs-36], and date properties surface objects on daily notes [capacities-docs-8]. Tags are confirmed by community users [capacities-comm-2], and retrieval is covered by search and Smart queries [capacities-docs-22][capacities-docs-27]. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the available property types and of tag management, explicit evidence that Smart queries filter or retrieve by property or tag values, and hands-on corroboration of consistent property use across a space.
